headline: Tencent scientist warns AI biology skills near a harm threshold
body: A quieter Saturday. Tencent's chief AI scientist warned that AI biology skills are near a 'can do harm' threshold, and Google DeepMind said AI found new weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA. Both raised Catastrophic Risk, which rose 0.31. OpenAI closed an $11 billion first tranche at a $1.25 trillion valuation, below its earlier target, nudging Power Concentration up. Self-Destruction rose and the two utopias slipped. Horizon Balance fell to -10.23 from -10.05.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.3, from the Tencent warning (+0.26) and DeepMind's RSA finding (+0.12), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.04). Libertarian Utopia -0.2, mostly from the Tencent warning (-0.12) and DeepMind's RSA finding (-0.05). Reversion +0.2, mostly from the Tencent warning (+0.10) and fading earlier news (+0.05).
